teaches: A health question: plan the facts and the mechanism, never what the listener should do; the self-help line is left out; land on the most concrete fact about treatment, not on advice.

packet.title: What autoimmune disease is
sentences: The body destroys most of the immune cells it makes in the bone marrow and thymus before they are released.
Cells that react to the body's own tissue are removed in that screening.
An autoimmune disease occurs when a self-reactive cell escapes that check and attacks the body's own tissue.
Rheumatoid arthritis affects the lining of the joints, type one diabetes the insulin-making cells of the pancreas, and alopecia areata the hair follicles.
More than eighty diseases are classed as autoimmune.

packet.title: Causes and treatment
sentences: Researchers point to a combination of genes that make the screening leaky and environmental triggers such as infections.
The conditions cluster in families without being simply inherited.
Biologic drugs each block one specific immune signal, so a drug that works for one disease may not work for another.
Anyone with symptoms should speak to their doctor about testing.
